_doc: Laçın (0.20.1, a short Qarabağ map): a 1.5 km two-lane loop in the Həkəri valley. The west leg runs beside the river (the boulevard and the garden café between the road and the water), the east leg through the town (LaCinema, Lachin Resort & Spa, the new houses), Hoçaz rising beyond the river. control: [x, y, z, full_width, theme 4 = forest]. Terrain: tools/blender/karabakh_terrain.py --track karabakh_lachin. Landmarks: tools/karabakh_maps_layout.py.
